description: This course focuses on the development of web applications using modern technologies and methodologies. Topics include HTML5 and CSS3 for front-end development; JavaScript ES6+ and frameworks like React and Vue.js for dynamic client-side interactions; backend technologies such as Node.js, Express.js, and Python with Flask or Django for server-side logic; RESTful API design and implementation using JSON and XML; database integration with MySQL, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL; server-side templating with Jade and EJS; authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth2 and JWT; deployment strategies with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms like AWS and Azure; and performance optimization techniques including caching and load balancing. Students will also explore web accessibility standards and security best practices.

clos.text: Define the structure and syntax of HTML5 and CSS3 for creating responsive and accessible web pages.
Describe the components and lifecycle of a React component, including state management and props.
Explain the principles of RESTful API design and implement a CRUD API using Node.js and Express.js.
Apply database normalization principles to design and implement a relational database schema using MySQL.
Evaluate the security implications of common web vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and XSS and implement mitigation strategies using JWT and HTTPS.

topics: JavaScript ES6+ syntax and DOM manipulation

labs: Create a React component for a to-do list with state and event handling
Build a Vue.js application for a product catalog with filtering and sorting
Develop a RESTful API for a book database using Express.js
Implement a MongoDB-based user authentication system using Mongoose
Design and implement a RESTful API for a task management system
Create a relational database schema for an e-commerce system using MySQL
Implement user authentication with OAuth2 and JWT in a Node.js application
Containerize a Node.js application and deploy it to Kubernetes
Deploy a web application to AWS Elastic Beanstalk
Optimize a web application's performance using caching and load balancing
Audit and improve the accessibility of a web application

topics: Security best practices for web applications
labs: Implement security measures against XSS and CSRF in a React application
Present and defend a final project demonstrating full-stack web application development
